caption: The drawing depicts a piece of furniture consisting of a wooden table with four slender, turned legs. The tabletop is polygonal, featuring subtle brown shading and wood grain details. Under the tabletop, there are two yellow-brown drawers with round, brass-colored handles and decorative beading along the edges. Below the drawers hangs a gathered fabric pouch, light grayish with a white and beige, vertical leafy pattern. Above the table, there is a horizontal rectangular object featuring a checkered pattern alternating between dark brown and reddish squares. The scene is enclosed by a thin, outlined rectangular border on a cream-colored background.
title: Sewing Table
